report:
1. RESULT: one labelled (assumption), one no-carrier (estimate). Commit 8325f2d0.

2. EVIDENCE: specs/sprint-phoenix-epic/evidence/PHX-WP-VAC02/node-test.tap, written by node's own tap reporter; command in evidence.command above; exit 0; 21 pass / 0 fail (7 pre-existing model tests + 1 new, 7 pre-existing renderer tests + 1 new, 4 pre-existing CLI tests). Searches: (a) grep valueClass|estimate|assumption|projected|derived|computed in evidence-view-model.mjs -> only fact/invalid/redacted/unavailable produced, notice(valueClass, code, message) is the whole threading mechanism; (b) grep estimate|assumption in evidence-view-renderer.mjs, scripts/evidence-viewer.mjs, assets/evidence-viewer.css -> zero hits, confirming absence; (c) grep -l estimate across plugins/ and harness/ -> lib/gate-estimate.mjs, config/gate-estimate-phase-map.v1.json, scripts/gate-estimate-evidence.schema.json, continuity-status.mjs, pipeline-state.mjs; (d) grep lag in governance-export-outbox.mjs -> zero, so exportStatus.lag has no in-repo producer and its semantics are only shape-validated; (e) grep createHash|sha256 in feature-package-topology.mjs -> lines 116 and 220 re-hash every artifact against its bytes, so artifact state=verified/valueClass=fact is a genuine fact and must NOT be relabelled; (f) grep assumptionState in agent-decision-journal.mjs -> the journal's assumption kind is observational only and the viewer has no path to it; (g) grep data-value-class|outputSha256 in scripts/evidence-viewer.test.mjs -> no HTML/digest pins, so the renderer label change breaks no existing check.

3. CARRIERS. assumption = REAL, already rendered: the caller-supplied governance-export delivery observation (exportObservation -> model.exportStatus -> renderer exportBlock). evidence-view-model.mjs exportStatus() admits it on shape alone - no digest, no canonical source record, no exact-candidate binding, no timestamp - and scripts/evidence-viewer.mjs reads it with JSON.parse from any operator-chosen relative path, while every other value labelled fact is digest-bound. Destination profile, cursor and lag were labelled fact; they are now assumption, absent values still unavailable, plus a declared notice(assumption, EVM-EXPORT-ASSUMED). estimate = CONFIRMED NO CARRIER in the viewer's rendered output. The repo's one real estimate is the coordinator gate ETA: pipeline.gate-estimate.v1 with rangeMinutes {min,max}, evidence- and sourceOid-bound, projected by projectGateEstimate() in lib/gate-estimate.mjs and surfaced by continuity-status.mjs - a different report. The viewer has no input path to it: buildEvidenceViewModelFromFeaturePackage is deliberately the only filesystem-facing entry point and only reads the validated feature-package manifest. Wiring the gate estimate in would mean a new CLI flag plus a pipeline-state read, i.e. new viewer input plumbing, not labelling - an Elephant-level design call, so it is reported rather than invented.

4. DEVIATIONS: none from the briefing. Two judgement calls disclosed: (i) I did not relabel exportStatus.state, which keeps its own state-named class (delivered/quarantined/...), the pre-existing convention this renderer uses for topology, report status and artifact integrity - changing one such value only there would be inconsistent; (ii) the EVM-EXPORT-ASSUMED notice is emitted on the valid-topology path only, not on the two invalid-topology early returns, which emit a single invalid notice and render no claims (the renderer still labels their observation values assumption).

5. OPEN ITEMS: (a) V-AC-02's estimate class stays unsatisfied-by-absence; the Elephant decides whether surfacing the gate ETA in the viewer is in-epic scope. (b) The stale comment in evidence-view-renderer.test.mjs that claimed both classes were absent everywhere is corrected and now points at the gate-estimate carrier. (c) Not changed on purpose: artifact state=verified stays fact (digest-verified); per-artifact lifecycleState stays the package state; evidence/phx-wp-v.txt from the earlier WP was not updated (Elephant-owned). (d) The Elephant still needs to update acceptance.md / acceptance-evidence-map.mjs / closure-plan.md, which this dispatch was forbidden to touch. (e) dispatch-record.json is intentionally left uncommitted because its report field is written after the commit.
